description: Plain-English screen requests (insight plan I10.4). Each case is one sentence and the draft a correct parse produces: filters as [metric_id, op, value] in the metric's unit (fractions as decimals), markets as ISO alpha-2 codes, industries as stored names, whether it must be refused, and the phrases that must be reported as unmatched (a substring of some unmatched phrase). Scored by steward/discovery/parse_eval.py; the gate is evals/screen_parse_gate.json. Re-run when the metric registry changes (its hash is in the gate).
